note: Each verdict is the one the design page fixes for that bank from its construction (true paired effect and number of roots), before any score was computed. Reason and stage name the gate step that decides it; analysis is the status the unchanged fixed analysis reports beside it. descriptive_relation is the Pareto relation of the descriptive report (descriptive only, never part of a verdict) for the bank with no resource contract, so quality is the one objective: the true paired effect of a bank sets it, and the bounds of the ungraded arms set it for mixed_unknowns. Changing a value here is changing a pre-registered expectation, never tuning a fixture to a number.
